name: Farming Smock
description: [Light Armor] Sturdy, practical, covered in soil.

name: Leather Jerkin
description: [Light Armor] Boiled leather. Quiet, cheap, adequate.

name: Chain Shirt
description: [Heavy Armor] Heavy, and worth it.

name: Family Plate
description: [Heavy Armor] Polished daily by someone with time.

name: Sister's Habit
description: [Magic Armor] Practical, washable, deceptively warm.

name: Travelling Robe
description: [Magic Armor] Has more pockets than it appears to.

name: Buckler
description: [Small Shield] A small round shield.

name: Kite Shield
description: [Large Shield] Enough to stand behind.

name: Wide Hat
description: [Magic Armor] Keeps the rain and the questions off.

name: Great Helm
description:
[Heavy Armor] Excellent protection, no peripheral vision.
This may explain a lot about Sir Aldric.

name: Plain Circlet
description: [General Armor] Unassuming. Steadies the mind.

name: Ring of Mild Fortune
description: [Accessory] Things go slightly your way.

name: Hasty Ring
description: [Accessory] You arrive before you have decided to.

name: Amulet of the Committee
description: [Accessory] Resists darkness, and most forms of paperwork.

name: Walking Boots
description:
[Accessory] Broken in by somebody who walked a long way in
them and came back with opinions.

name: Oilskin Coat
description:
[Light Armor] Nether Sopping's answer to Nether Sopping.
Sheds water, weather and most opinions.

name: A Hat
description:
[General Armor] A hat. Form A-1 requires a hat and does not
say which, so Mrs Barrow sells this one.

name: Keeper's Lamp
description:
[Accessory] A small lamp off a large lighthouse. It is what
the ones who come back walk home by.

name: Feud Locket
description:
[Accessory] Two sisters, one portrait each, facing
resolutely away. Thirty years of this.

name: Footnote
description:
[Accessory] Hosea Bellwether has written you into the
history. Small type, bottom of the page, but there.

name: The Forty-Fourth's Signet
description:
[Accessory] Grave goods, given rather than taken, which he
was very particular about.

name: Ysolde's Kit
description:
[Accessory] Forty years of field medicine in one canvas
roll. She does not need it any more. You will.

name: Sensible Trousers
description:
[General Armor] Nobody in this story is dressed for the
weather. These are. That is the whole of the pitch.

name: Works Cap
description:
[General Armor] The hooter sounds at six. A cap does not
help with that and everybody wears one anyway.

name: The Fuse (Removed)
description:
[Accessory] Taken out first, before anything else was
touched. Carry it and you will not be surprised again.

name: Governor
description:
[Accessory] A brass ball governor off Attempt Eighty-Four.
It kept her from running away with herself.
